description: Tommy's taste for motion graphics videos (launch videos, promo videos, product demos, explainers): something always moves, long animations with fast easing so a soft tail keeps moving, a camera that never stops, eased slide transitions between scenes (out with ease in, in with ease out), pacing that is fast but leaves time to read, cuts on the music beat, showing the real product working, one hero per beat with big readable type, a beat table before building, and example styles. Independent of the renderer (HyperFrames, Remotion, three.js, headless Chrome). ALWAYS load this skill before you design, animate, edit or review a motion graphics video, a scene transition, a camera move or video pacing.
